a1
Isaac blessed Jacob and sent him to Paddan-aram, to find a wife among Laban's daughters, not among the Canaanites.
a2
Jacob left Beersheba for Haran. At sunset he stopped for the night, and slept with a stone for a pillow.
b1
He dreamed of a stairway set on the earth, its top reaching heaven, with angels of God going up and down.
b2
The Lord stood beside him: I am the God of Abraham and Isaac. The land you lie on, I give to you and your descendants.
b3
All the families of the earth will be blessed through you. I am with you, and I will not leave you.
c1
Jacob woke, afraid: the Lord is in this place, and I did not know it. This is the gate of heaven.
c2
In the morning he set up the stone, poured oil on it, and named the place Bethel, house of God.
h1
Jacob was running from his brother, alone, with a stone for a pillow.
h2
Yet God was in that place, and he had not known it.
h3
God meets us on the road, even on our worst night.
h4
Today, say it: the Lord is here, even now.
i
Where is God already present in your life today?
